findings.problem: Unbounded recursive hashing/decoding of deeply nested opaque values could exhaust stack/resources; a naive breadth-sized guard also imposed excess media memory overhead.
findings.fix: Bound depth, strings, nodes and finite numbers before recursive work; use depth-sized iterator frames.
findings.verification: final-security.test.ts plus invalid-preview/fresh-profile/rollback regressions; 358 units and full browser suites

findings.problem: Generic URL schemas admitted executable/non-web schemes in provenance fields; no active exploit of these fields is claimed.
findings.fix: Owning schemas require bounded HTTP(S) source/media/registry URLs; generated schemas preserved.
findings.verification: Unsafe protocol rejection with valid HTTPS controls; whole-module restore validation

findings.problem: Declared upload MIME was not compared to magic bytes before decoding.

findings.problem: Zod caught an eval capability probe rejected by CSP; console-only checks missed its policy event.

findings.verification: Chromium/WebKit targeted 8/8; final browser/route gates; old live event recorded as known blocked probe pending redeploy

findings.problem: Credential-bearing origins were silently normalized and accepted.

findings.problem: Readonly checkout credentials were unnecessarily retained in test workspaces.

findings.verification: Workflow source review and five fresh successful hosted jobs
